axe_one_man_army.name: One Man Army
axe_one_man_army.description: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.

axe_berserkers_call.name: Berserker's Call
axe_berserkers_call.description: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
axe_berserkers_call.shard_description: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
axe_berserkers_call.facet_axe_call_out: Berserker's Call gives Axe increased bonus armor and increases the attack speed of the affected units.
axe_berserkers_call.abilitydraft_note: Must draft Battle Hunger for Scepter upgrade to work.
axe_berserkers_call.lore: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.

axe_battle_hunger.name: Battle Hunger
axe_battle_hunger.description: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
axe_battle_hunger.shard_description: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
axe_battle_hunger.note0: This effect is also removed if a building is destroyed.
axe_battle_hunger.lore: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.

axe_counter_helix.name: Counter Helix
axe_counter_helix.description: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
axe_counter_helix.scepter_description: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
axe_counter_helix.note0: Triggers upon completion of an attack on the caster.
axe_counter_helix.note1: Illusions' attacks are not counted toward the trigger when using Aghanim's Scepter.
axe_counter_helix.lore: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.

axe_culling_blade.name: Culling Blade
axe_culling_blade.description: Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.\n\nAxe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
axe_culling_blade.note0: This kill cannot be prevented by abilities like Shallow Grave.
axe_culling_blade.lore: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.
